cases.sentence: Но им придется покориться ему, чтобы они познали разницу между служением Мне и служением царям ___.
cases.explain: «чужих земель» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

cases.sentence: Когда Шишак, царь Египта, пришел в Иерусалим, он унес сокровища дома Господа и сокровища ___.
cases.explain: «царского дворца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

cases.sentence: Он забрал все, включая и ___, которые сделал Соломон.
cases.explain: «золотые щиты» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

cases.sentence: Царь Ровоам сделал ___, чтобы заменить их, и вверил их начальникам стражи, что охраняла вход в царский дворец.
cases.explain: «бронзовые щиты» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

cases.sentence: Царь Ровоам сделал бронзовые щиты, чтобы заменить их, и вверил их начальникам стражи, что охраняла вход в ___.
cases.explain: «царский дворец» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

cases.sentence: Всякий раз, когда царь шел в ___, стража со щитами шла с ним, а после этого возвращала их в комнату стражи.
cases.explain: «Господний дом» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.
